description: Use when you need free supplied-data rules only; no external evidence or signed receipt. Provide the spent-today context. No automatic paid upgrade. Free rules-only review of a supplied x402 challenge or cart. Rules-only review of caller-supplied data. No sanctions, domain/DNS, identity, cached price/history, liveness, delivery or wallet-authority verification. No signed receipt. An allow decision is not permission to pay. Pass spent_today_usd, including zero, to evaluate the daily cap. Use preflight_payment explicitly for the separate 0.02 USDC screened and signed check. Shared anonymous per-instance 30/minute HTTP+MCP limit.

cart.description: Optional. Checkout JSON object used instead of challenge; provide exactly one. Example: {"merchant_domain":"example.com","total_usd":1.25,"pay_to":"0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58"}. total_usd is a USD number.

merchant_domain.description: Optional. Merchant hostname or URL string. Example: shop.example.com. Omit if unknown.

merchant_name.description: Optional. Merchant legal-name string. Example: Example Trading Ltd. Omit if unknown.

total_usd.description: Optional. Cart total as a nonnegative USD number. Example: 1.25. Omit if unknown; do not supply atomic units.

challenge.description: Optional. Actual x402 HTTP 402 PaymentRequired JSON object, version 1 or 2. Required unless cart is supplied; provide exactly one. Example structure: {"x402Version":2,"resource":{"url":"https://api.example.com/data"},"accepts":[{"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453","asset":"0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913","payTo":"0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58","amount":"10000","maxTimeoutSeconds":60}]}. Amounts inside challenges are atomic integer strings (10000 = 0.01 USDC at 6 decimals), not decimal USDC.

resource_method.description: Optional. Advertised HTTP method string, 3–16 letters. Example: POST. Supply when an indexed URL has multiple methods.

resource_url.description: Optional. Absolute HTTP(S) resource URL string. Example: https://api.example.com/data. Supply if the resource URL is absent from the challenge or requirement.

rules.description: Optional. Spending-rule JSON object; omitted fields use service defaults available from get_service_info. Example: {"max_per_payment_usd":5,"usdc_only":true}. USD amounts are numbers, not atomic strings.

allowed_networks.description: Optional. Array of allowed network identifier strings. Example: ["eip155:8453"]. Omit to use the service default.

daily_cap_usd.description: Optional. Nonnegative daily spending cap number in USD. Example: 20. Omit to use the service default.

domain_allowlist.description: Optional. Array of allowed merchant hostname strings. Example: ["example.com"]. Omit to use the service default.

domain_blocklist.description: Optional. Array of blocked merchant hostname strings. Example: ["blocked.example"]. Omit to use the service default.

hold_above_usd.description: Optional. Nonnegative hold threshold number in USD. Example: 1. Omit to use the service default.

hold_on_payto_change.description: Optional. Boolean holding on an observed recipient change. Example: true. Defaults to true.

max_per_payment_usd.description: Optional. Positive per-payment cap number in USD. Example: 5. Omit to use the service default.

max_price_multiple.description: Optional. Positive price-to-observed-median ratio number, or null to disable. Example: 5 means five times the median. Defaults to 5.

new_domain_days.description: Optional. New-domain age threshold as a nonnegative number of days. Example: 30. Omit to use the service default.

payto_allowlist.description: Optional. Array of allowed recipient address strings. Example: ["0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58"]. Omit to use the service default.

payto_blocklist.description: Optional. Array of blocked recipient address strings. Example: ["0xBf4164e07552e4c1b1B1597E72C7acAA3F0a1c58"]. Omit to use the service default.

require_live.description: Optional. Boolean holding after three usable failed unpaid probes. Example: true. Defaults to true; missing evidence is not a failed probe.

screen_sanctions.description: Optional. Boolean enabling payee sanctions screening. Example: true. Omit to use the service default.

strict_allowlist.description: Optional. Boolean requiring allowlist membership. Example: true. Omit to use the service default.

usdc_only.description: Optional. Boolean restricting supported payment assets to USDC. Example: true. Omit to use the service default.

spent_today_usd.description: Optional. Already-spent daily total as a nonnegative USD number. Example: 2.5. Caller-supplied context for the daily cap.

name: preflight_basic
title: Free basic payment-rule check
